acceptance.authored_roundtrip: all 36 table names/order, exact columns/instance names, 25 populated authored tables; all-null placeholder only for wholly empty tables; declared double cells use exact Decimal equality or the exact 17-significant-digit spelling of the authored finite binary64 value (no tolerance); strict other cells and exact h5 change row
acceptance.no_immediate_change_trigger: no system SURP task starts at hour 5
acceptance.post_change_duration: every completed system SURP task lasts 1.5 hours within 0.00011 hours
acceptance.physical_cycle: each damage identity matches demand, direct-repair start and completion, and stock return; each demand has one coincident spare issue
acceptance.opening_spare_flow: each later spare issue uses the prior repaired return and occurs after that return
acceptance.raw_reports: retain the complete native report and all 4044 typed cells; require exact accepted four-table roster and ordered column schemas. Reconcile every half-hour interval and total-row identity, NDAM/NREPT/NDD/NWT/NBO integer event bins, PNB, the NSYRY/NSYMA/NSYUA/NSYA state partitions, NSYRP exposure against task durations, NFAIL/NSYLA, and terminal NSYRY/MSTF/MSUF. Other raw report metric values are preserved but are outside this variant's asserted metric scope.
acceptance.failure_handling: one native attempt; preserve every file and hash on failure; no in-directory retry

limits: single fixed-seed source, one station, one mother-system/child-item record, one scheduled SURPT update
does not establish GUI behavior, cross-engine equivalence, other schedule fields, same-time precedence, active-task changes, general stochastic timing, or full I05.var05 family
publication_state remains not_published until independent postrun replay and authorized publication review
